title: Land Deal Boosts Austin Affordable Housing
summary:
*   An option was approved for a community development group to purchase land from the Austin Housing Finance Corporation.
*   This land is specifically earmarked for the construction of new low-income rental units.
*   The project aims to create affordable housing opportunities, utilizing tax credits for financing.
transcript:
MINUTES OF THE
AUSTIN HOUSING FINANCE CORPORATION
BOARD OF DIRECTOR'S MEETING
September 14, 1995
The meeting was called to order at 3:50 p.m. Present:
Absent:
Max Nofziger, Ronney Reynolds, Jackie Goodman, Gus Garcia, Eric Mitchell
Bruce Todd, Brigid Shea
Agenda Item No. 53 (1) Approve a resolution authorizing the General Manager or his
designee to execute a six month option granting the Anderson Community Development
Corporation (ACDC) the right to purchase certain parcels of land as described in attached
exhibit "A", currently owned by the Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC), for the
purpose of building low income tax credit financed rental units in the SCIP 2 area.
Motion
a
The Board, on Board Member Eric Mitchell's motion and Board Member Gus Garcia's second,
approved the execution of
six month option granting ACDC the
right to purchase certain parcels of land owned by AHFC with a 5-0-2 vote. Board Members
Bruce Todd and
Brigid Shea were absent.
The meeting was adjourned at 3:52 p.m.
